title: Make the built site follow the light/dark switch
description: Appends cat-harness's darkRules (scripts/lib/scheme-css.ts) of the dark scheme's flat rules to the site's assets/ihris.css, so the dark colours apply when the OS is dark and the reader has not picked light, or whenever the reader picked dark; and adds cat-harness's withSavedScheme snippet to every page's head, so a reader's choice is restored at first paint. Run by build_site.py; it styles nothing itself.

install.cli: bun install (from this repository's package.json); the platform mounted by src/tools/mount_platform.sh
